experiments.name: model_mix
experiments.scope: Equal-workload relative-price scenarios at ratios two, three and four
experiments.claim_limit: No model-specific token use or bill measured

experiments.name: erasure_channel
experiments.scope: Five exact finite joint laws and zero-one Bayes risks
experiments.claim_limit: No physical or cognitive observable mapping

experiments.name: sequential_likelihood
experiments.scope: Enumerate every binary path through horizon ten under a conditional fair-coin null
experiments.claim_limit: No empirical data or universal sequential test

experiments.name: correlated_null_counterexample
experiments.scope: A shared fair latent bit makes all observations identical
experiments.claim_limit: The counterexample rejects marginal-fairness sufficiency, not the correctly conditional theorem

experiments.name: unit_fraction_classes
experiments.scope: Verify explicit constructions for even n, multiples of three, and n congruent to three modulo four, over integers two through five hundred
experiments.claim_limit: Remaining integers stay unproved; no new bound or universal Erdos-Straus solution

experiments.name: bounded_record_loading
experiments.scope: Five paired local timings comparing fifty repeated decodes with one decode and fifty selections; require exact selected-output parity
experiments.claim_limit: Measures only this data-loading helper, not language-model speed, tokens, quality or energy
